Skill `hiring-screener`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `read_rubric_and_applications` (owner `agent`): via `read`; adds `rubric_available`, `applications_available`, `evidence_extracted`.
Tool `ask_for_rubric` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; adds `rubric_available`.
Tool `ask_for_voice_samples` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; requires `applications_available`; adds `voice_profile_available`.
Tool `render_shortlist_artifact` (owner `agent`): via `artifact`; requires `ranked_shortlist_ready`; adds `artifact_ready`.
Initially true: none.
Goal: all of (`rubric_available`, `evidence_extracted`, `ranked_shortlist_ready`, `draft_replies_ready`, `artifact_ready`, `onboarding_checklist_ready`, `payroll_handoff_ready`).
Protocol:
  - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `rubric_found_in_files`:
      - `agent` uses `read_rubric_and_applications`.
    - branch `rubric_missing_build_with_user`:
      - `agent` uses `ask_for_rubric`.
      - `agent` uses `read_rubric_and_applications`.
  - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `voice_profile_available`: none.
    - branch `no_voice_profile`:
      - `user` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `provide_voice_samples`:
          - `agent` uses `ask_for_voice_samples`.
        - branch `decline_voice_samples`: none.
  - `agent` uses `rank_candidates`.
  - `agent` uses `draft_candidate_replies`.
  - `agent` uses `prepare_onboarding_and_payroll_handoff`.
  - `agent` uses `render_shortlist_artifact`.
